name: Hollowcrown Dragon - Young
description: Young Hollowcrown is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with blackened gold scales and a broken halo. It seeks to compel obedience from subjects who no longer exist. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Crowned Talons
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Royal Brand
abilities.description: The dragon knows the direction of every creature branded by its breath within Far range.

abilities.name: Sovereign Flame
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the target is branded with a visible crown until the end of the scene. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
